newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Keladi Maju debuts at 3.86 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Keladi Maju debuts at 3.86 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysian property developer Keladi Maju Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board on Wednesday at 3.86 ringgit, against a 2.80 ringgit offer price.
The company offered 9.479 million shares, with gross proceeds expected to total 26.54 million ringgit. At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 3.80 ringgit.
The company develops mainly low- and medium-cost residential projects, commercial offices, as well as light industrial factory buildings.
For the year ended January 31, 1997, Keladi Maju reported net profit of 12.17 million ringgit or 22.46 cents a share on turnover of 34.86 million ringgit.
That compared with net profit of 9.75 million ringgit or 18.00 cents a share on turnover of 39.81 million ringgit in the previous comparable year.
It has forecast a net profit of 14.64 million ringgit or 20.74 cents a share for the year ended January 31, 1998.
